text:
Three charges on my debit card from last weekend were not made by me: 89.90 euros at a webshop called Kaasboer Online, 214.00 euros at a petrol station in Lille that I have never visited, and 45.00 euros to a streaming service I do not subscribe to. The card itself was in my wallet the whole time, so I do not think it was lost or stolen.

I was in hospital from Friday evening until Sunday afternoon after an emergency appendix operation, so I could not have made any of these purchases. My sister Marit Kuipers collected my phone and wallet from the ward on Sunday and can confirm that the card never left it.

The card ending 4417 is linked to the account of Sanne Verbeek, and the case reference I was given on the phone is FR-60418. The bank adviser, Mr Dirk Hoekstra, said I should reply to him within five working days. I would prefer a reply by email to sanne.verbeek@example.invalid, because I cannot take calls at work.

text:
On Tuesday 14 October at about 21:40 I received a text asking me to confirm a parcel delivery, and I tapped the link before I noticed the sender looked odd. Within twenty minutes two transfers had left my current account: 6,400 kroner to an account I do not recognise, and 3,150 kroner to a second one. I did not approve either transfer with my MitID, and I rang the bank's emergency line at 22:15 to block the account.

The adviser who took my call was called Pernille Andersen, and my customer number is 7740-2291; you can reach me on +45 31 55 02 74 until 17:00 on weekdays.

Because of the missing money I now cannot pay my 7,900 kroner rent on 1 November. I was made redundant from my job as a warehouse planner in September and I am living on severance pay of 14,000 kroner a month until the end of the year, so the missing 9,550 kroner is about two thirds of what I have left. My landlord, Jesper Lund, has already said he cannot wait past the 5th.
task: Draft a message asking the bank what interim help they can offer me while the investigation runs.

text:
At 03:12 on Saturday the nightly export job for the parcel-tracking service started retrying every two seconds after the object store returned HTTP 503. Each retry opened a new connection, the pool of 200 connections was exhausted by 03:20, and the API began answering with timeouts. The retry loop, introduced in release 4.18, had no backoff and no cap, and that is the cause. We stopped the job at 03:41 and the API recovered at 03:44.

Our usual on-call engineer, Nynke de Wit, is on secondment to the platform team in Utrecht until 20 June, so Thijs Aalbers carries the pager for the next three weeks. Thijs has not worked on the export service before and has asked for a short handover covering where the job is configured and who to wake up if it fails again.

Fix: backoff with jitter, a maximum of five attempts, and an alert when open connections pass 150. The change is in branch fix-export-backoff and needs a review from Sigrid Madsen before it ships on Tuesday.

text: Steps for ordering a replacement debit card in the banking app: open the Cards tab, select the card you want to replace, and tap Replace card. Choose whether the old card is lost, stolen or damaged. A lost or stolen card is blocked immediately, while a damaged card stays active until the new one is activated. The new card arrives in five to seven working days, and the standard fee is 8.50 euros unless the card was kept by a machine. Activate the new card by making one chip and PIN payment of any amount. Contactless payments will work again after that first payment. If the card has not arrived after ten working days, contact the bank through the app chat.
